items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I certainly did. That was one of the best sessions I ever had.

ctx.x: So he enjoyed it. Well, didn't you tell me that Koenig called you afterwards about that session?
Yeah, he wanted to ask me something, and he said, Previn called and told me to ask you, could he be on your next session and I said, 'are you kidding?' I'd love to have him on all the sessions.
Oh, that was good. Well listen, in 1960 you made a session with strings, do you remember?
